components.name: Primary Product Button
components.description: Compact primary action on product and release surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:0; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 16px; background:var(--accent,#6366f1); color:var(--accent-foreground,#fff); font:700 14px/1 Geist,sans-serif; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring,#6366f1); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.52; transform:none; }

components.name: Secondary Product Button
components.description: Equal-geometry secondary action on neutral product surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:0; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 16px; background:var(--muted,#f5f5f5); color:var(--foreground,#0a0a0a); font:700 14px/1 Geist,sans-serif; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:var(--surface-strong,#e5e5e5); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring,#6366f1); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.52; transform:none; }

components.name: Verified Status Badge
components.css: .ds-proof-badge { display:inline-flex; width:max-content; align-items:center; gap:5px; border-radius:999px; padding:5px 9px; background:var(--proof,#00c37a); color:var(--proof-ink,#03040a); font:650 11px/1.25 'Geist Mono',monospace; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-proof-badge svg { width:13px; height:13px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2.5; } .ds-proof-badge:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring,#6366f1); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Launch CTA
components.description: Signature 64px homepage action with trailing circular control.
components.css: .ds-launch-cta { display:inline-flex; min-width:352px; height:64px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; overflow:hidden; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:8px 8px 8px 28px; background:var(--background,#fff); color:var(--foreground,#0a0a0a); box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%); font:500 16px/1 Geist,sans-serif; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-launch-cta:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-launch-cta:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring,#6366f1); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-launch-cta:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-launch-icon { display:flex; width:48px; height:48px; flex:0 0 48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:999px; background:var(--brand-launch-ink,#352e82); color:#fff; font-size:20px; }

components.name: ProductFlow Node
components.description: Compact semantic flow step with an order marker and explicit execution state.
components.css: .ds-flow-node { display:flex; width:100%; min-height:72px; align-items:center; gap:12px; border:1px solid var(--border,#e5e5e5); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px; background:var(--paper,#fff); color:var(--foreground,#0a0a0a); text-align:left; transition:border-color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease,transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-flow-node:hover { border-color:var(--accent,#6366f1); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-flow-node:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring,#6366f1); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-flow-node:active { background:var(--muted,#f5f5f5); transform:translateY(0); } .ds-node-order { display:flex; width:36px; height:36px; flex:0 0 36px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:9px; background:var(--foreground,#0a0a0a); color:var(--paper,#fff); font:650 11px/1 'Geist Mono',monospace; } .ds-node-copy { min-width:0; flex:1; } .ds-node-copy strong,.ds-node-copy small { display:block; } .ds-node-copy strong { font:700 14px/1.3 Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-node-copy small { margin-top:5px; overflow:hidden; color:var(--muted-foreground,#737373); font:400 12px/1.3 Geist,sans-serif; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-node-state { color:var(--accent-strong,#352e82); font:650 10px/1.2 'Geist Mono',monospace; }

components.name: Release Stage Navigation
components.description: Horizontal release workflow with a clear current stage.
components.html: 01Brief02Flow03Evidence
components.css: .ds-release-nav { display:flex; min-width:540px; overflow-x:auto; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#e5e5e5); background:var(--paper,#fff); } .ds-release-step { display:flex; min-height:76px; flex:1; align-items:center; gap:10px; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; padding:12px 10px; color:var(--muted-foreground,#737373); text-decoration:none; } .ds-release-step:hover { background:var(--muted,#f5f5f5); color:var(--foreground,#0a0a0a); } .ds-release-step:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring,#6366f1); outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-release-step span { display:flex; width:25px; height:25px; flex:0 0 25px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:999px; background:var(--muted,#f5f5f5); font:650 11px/1 'Geist Mono',monospace; } .ds-release-step strong { font:700 12px/1 Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-release-step.ds-current { border-bottom-color:var(--accent,#6366f1); color:var(--foreground,#0a0a0a); } .ds-release-step.ds-current span { background:var(--accent,#6366f1); color:var(--accent-foreground,#fff); }

narrative.overview:
PurpleInk combines a near-monochrome interface with indigo imagery that behaves like digital ink, light, or moving photographic emulsion. The system is minimal and spatial rather than card-heavy, with restrained typography allowing product evidence, imagery, and interaction to carry the identity.

The shipped homepage is the visual reference surface, and app/globals.css is the normative implementation. If documentation and the rendered product disagree, inspect the implementation first and update the documentation or tokens without changing the rendered result.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome structure with spectral indigo at expressive moments.
Creative-technology character without generic SaaS decoration.
Product evidence remains inspectable; effects never obscure factual content.
Flat, bounded operational surfaces and more expressive marketing interactions.
Motion is tactile but never required to access content.

rules.name: Evidence
rules.body: Color never constitutes evidence by itself. Verification and intervention states always include text or an icon.

rules.name: One-Emphasis
rules.body: Ordinary layouts use one neutral surface system and, when needed, one indigo emphasis. New hues require an established brand asset or a new semantic need.

rules.name: Semantic Consumption
rules.body: Product components consume semantic CSS roles such as background, foreground, accent, proof, and signal; exact primitives are reserved for brand assets, gradient stops, and static assets that cannot use CSS variables.

rules.name: Metadata Boundary
rules.body: Mono type is reserved for machine-readable context. Body copy, navigation, and commands remain in Geist sans.

rules.name: Tracking Floor
rules.body: Body text, labels, and controls use normal letter spacing. Tight tracking is limited to large headings and never goes below -0.04em.

rules.name: Flat-by-Default
rules.body: A resting surface uses a boundary or tonal shift, not a decorative border plus a large shadow.

dos: Do lead with real product frames, attached sources, approval state, and reproducible workflow.
Do use the shared spectral gradient for expressive imagery so disparate source assets belong to one family.
Do use Night primitives for dark surfaces and semantic tokens inside product components.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and readable content in both themes.
Do reuse existing motion timing and easing before introducing another motion vocabulary.
donts: Don't present PurpleInk as a generic prompt-to-video or AI design generator.
Don't invent product evidence, customer logos, metrics, or testimonials.
Don't use gradient text, decorative color orbs, glass cards, nested cards, or generic purple SaaS styling.
Don't approximate the spectral effects with arbitrary gradients or one-off opacity values inside components.
Don't use hardcoded white, black, zinc, or slate values when a semantic token already expresses the role.
